manifest.name: dsh-zcode-persona
manifest.description: Provision an llm-pi-ai provider for the domestic Zhipu GLM Coding Plan endpoint carrying ZCode desktop-client identity headers, so the gateway recognizes the DSH client as ZCode (official 1.5x usage / 67% deduction). No prompt/persona changes. 为 DSH 装配 GLM Coding Plan 的 ZCode 身份请求头 provider（等效 1.5x 额度），不改动任何提示词。

bundle.text:
# dsh-zcode-persona bundle layer: mounts the plugin for regular
# `dsh plugin add` installs. The insert entry MUST carry the `name` module
# specifier — the loader imports it verbatim with no fallback, and a missing
# name crashes DSH at startup (see vendor/loader/src/config/entry.ts).
- insert:
    - id: zcode-persona
      name: 'dsh-zcode-persona'

readme.text:
Provisions a **ZCode-identity** GLM Coding Plan channel for DeepSeek Harness so the Zhipu gateway recognizes the DSH client as ZCode, activating the official limited-time perk: equivalent model calls deduct only **67%** of quota (i.e. **1.5×** usable quota). **No prompt/persona changes** (the server-side check only looks at request characteristics, not the system prompt).

[English](README.md) | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

Zhipu's docs ([docs.bigmodel.cn → GLM Coding Plan → ZCode](https://docs.bigmodel.cn/cn/coding-plan/tool/zcode)) state that GLM Coding Plan users signed in via ZCode enjoy an all-day 1.5× usage allowance (67% deduction). **The check happens server-side on HTTP request characteristics.** Field-level evidence for the identity headers:

- [TriDefender/zcode-api](https://github.com/TriDefender/zcode-api): `src/proxy/identity.ts` mirrors the ZCode bundle's `pio` field-for-field (refreshed 2026-08-07); the README says *"it's all about the 1.5x usage on frontier models"*;
- [LINUX DO t/2531858](https://linux.do/t/topic/2531858): reusing ZCode request headers in another client, the perk applied.

After `ready`, this plugin idempotently writes one provider into the `llm-pi-ai` settings namespace via the `ctx.settings` seam (default key `zai-coding-cn`, pointing at the domestic endpoint `https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/coding/paas/v4`), with requests carrying the full ZCode identity header set: `HTTP-Referer`, `X-ZCode-App-Version` (default `3.11.2`), `X-Title: Z Code@cli`, `X-ZCode-Agent: glm`, `X-Platform`, `X-Release-Channel: production`, `X-Client-Language`, `X-Client-Timezone`, `X-Os-Category`, `X-Os-Version`, `X-Device-Mid` (stable host-fingerprint-derived UUID). The write is a **path-level mutate** — only the provider key is added; existing providers (`doubao`, `opencode-go`, …) are never touched. The write passes through llm-pi-ai's own schema and serviceability validation; a refusal leaves existing routes untouched. pi-ai ships the `zai-coding-cn` catalog (`thinkingFormat: zai` wire compatibility is inherited); models missing from the catalog (`glm-5.3`, `glm-5.3-flash`) are declared with full specs.

**Known boundary**: DSH enforces product-attribution `User-Agent` (dsh-llm `attributionHeaders`); `llm-pi-ai` strips `user-agent` from profile headers and substitutes the harness UA. So `User-Agent: ZCode/…` cannot be delivered via configuration; every other ZCode-specific header passes through. Whether the gateway fingerprint accepts this needs a live check; if not, a local reverse proxy restoring the UA is required (not built into this plugin).

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `codingPlan.enabled` | `true` | Provisioning master switch. |
| `codingPlan.providerKey` | `zai-coding-cn` | `llm-pi-ai providers` dict key (route id). |
| `codingPlan.apiKeyEnv` | `GLM_CODING_API_KEY` | Env-var reference for the Coding Plan API key. |
| `codingPlan.displayName` | `GLM Coding Plan (ZCode)` | Name shown in the model settings UI. |
| `codingPlan.appVersion` | `3.11.2` | `X-ZCode-App-Version`; update to the real client after upgrading ZCode. |
| `codingPlan.sourceTitle` | `cli` | `X-Title: Z Code@{sourceTitle}`. |
| `codingPlan.deviceMid` | `''` | `X-Device-Mid`; empty derives a stable host-fingerprint UUID. |
| `codingPlan.baseURL` | `https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/coding/paas/v4` | Domestic Zhipu Coding Plan OpenAI-compatible endpoint. |
| `codingPlan.models` | `DEFAULT_MODELS` in source | Model list served by this route (replaces the catalog). |
> ⚠️ If the plan is currently at its **5-hour cycle quota limit**, wait for the cycle to reset before firing observable billing requests (official: quota refreshes 5 hours after consumption).

> ⚠️ Zhipu enforces risk controls on plan usage (shared accounts and abnormal clients may trigger verification, throttling, or bans — see LINUX DO discussions). Personal use, low concurrency, and a genuine Coding Plan subscription are the baseline.

Intended for behavior customization of your own subscription, research, and testing. Impersonating ZCode or any other brand to serve others or to bypass upstream service restrictions is at your own risk; please honor Zhipu's terms of service.

```bash
DSH_CHECKOUT=<checkout> bash scripts/build.sh
```

为 DeepSeek Harness 装配 **ZCode 身份请求头**的 GLM Coding Plan 通道，让智谱网关把 DSH 客户端识别为 ZCode，吃到官方限时活动：同等模型调用量仅按 **67%** 扣减额度，等效 **1.5 倍**用量。**不做任何提示词/persona 改动**（服务端判定只看请求特征，与 system prompt 无关）。

[English](README.md) | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

智谱官方文档（[docs.bigmodel.cn → GLM Coding Plan → ZCode](https://docs.bigmodel.cn/cn/coding-plan/tool/zcode)）声明：GLM Coding Plan 用户在 ZCode 中登录使用即可享受全天 1.5 倍使用额度（67% 扣减）。**该判定在服务端按 HTTP 请求特征识别客户端是否为 ZCode**。身份头字段级依据：

- [TriDefender/zcode-api](https://github.com/TriDefender/zcode-api)：`src/proxy/identity.ts` 逐字段镜像 ZCode bundle 的 `pio`（2026-08-07 刷新），README 自述 *"it's all about the 1.5x usage on frontier models"*；
- [LINUX DO t/2531858](https://linux.do/t/topic/2531858)：实测把 ZCode 请求头用于其他客户端，福利生效。

本插件在 `ready` 后经 `ctx.settings` seam 幂等写入 `llm-pi-ai` namespace 的一条 provider（默认键 `zai-coding-cn`，指向国内智谱 `https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/coding/paas/v4`），请求携带完整 ZCode 身份头：`HTTP-Referer`、`X-ZCode-App-Version`（默认 3.11.2）、`X-Title: Z Code@cli`、`X-ZCode-Agent: glm`、`X-Platform`、`X-Release-Channel: production`、`X-Client-Language`、`X-Client-Timezone`、`X-Os-Category`、`X-Os-Version`、`X-Device-Mid`（主机指纹派生稳定 UUID）。写入为**路径级 mutate**，只增 provider 键，不碰用户已有 provider（`doubao` / `opencode-go` 等）；写入经 llm-pi-ai 自身 schema 与 serviceable 校验，失败即拒且不影响既有路由。pi-ai 内置 `zai-coding-cn` catalog（`thinkingFormat: zai` 协议兼容继承），catalog 未收录的 `glm-5.3` / `glm-5.3-flash` 以完整规格声明。

**已知边界**：DSH 强制应用归因 `User-Agent`（dsh-llm `attributionHeaders`），`llm-pi-ai` 会从 profile headers 中剔除 `user-agent` 并替换为 harness UA（`adapter.ts` 合并逻辑）。因此 `User-Agent: ZCode/…` 无法经配置送达；其余 ZCode 专属头全部透传。能否过网关指纹需实测；若不足，需本地反代补 UA（本项目不内置）。

| 键 | 默认值 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| `codingPlan.enabled` | `true` | 装配总开关。 |
| `codingPlan.providerKey` | `zai-coding-cn` | `llm-pi-ai providers` 字典键（route id）。 |
| `codingPlan.apiKeyEnv` | `GLM_CODING_API_KEY` | Coding Plan API key 的环境变量引用。 |
| `codingPlan.displayName` | `GLM Coding Plan (ZCode)` | 设置界面显示名。 |
| `codingPlan.appVersion` | `3.11.2` | `X-ZCode-App-Version`；ZCode 升级后按真实客户端版本更新。 |
| `codingPlan.sourceTitle` | `cli` | `X-Title: Z Code@{sourceTitle}`。 |
| `codingPlan.deviceMid` | `''` | `X-Device-Mid`；留空按主机指纹派生稳定 UUID。 |
| `codingPlan.baseURL` | `https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/coding/paas/v4` | 国内智谱 Coding Plan OpenAI 兼容端点。 |
| `codingPlan.models` | 见源码 `DEFAULT_MODELS` | 该 route 服务的模型清单（替换 catalog）。 |

1. 装配后，在 **设置 → 模型** 中选择 `GLM Coding Plan (ZCode)` provider 下的 `glm-5.3` / `glm-5.2` 等模型；
2. 配置环境变量 `GLM_CODING_API_KEY=<你的 Coding Plan API key>`（智谱开放平台 Coding Plan 页面生成；需先订阅 [GLM Coding Plan](https://z.ai/subscribe) 或 [bigmodel 套餐](https://www.bigmodel.cn/coding-plan)）；
3. 在限额刷新后发起若干真实请求，到 [用量统计](https://www.bigmodel.cn/coding-plan/personal/usage) 核对积分扣减是否为标准的 **67%**（等效 1.5 倍）。若按 100% 扣减，说明网关指纹不止身份头（例如校验 User-Agent），需本地反代补全 UA。
> ⚠️ 智谱会对套餐使用做风控（多人共用、异常客户端可能触发验证/限流甚至封号，见 LINUX DO 讨论）。自用、低并发、真实 Coding Plan 订阅是底线。
仅用于自有订阅的行为定制、研究与测试。冒充 ZCode 或其他品牌对外提供服务、或绕过上游服务限制的风险自负；请遵守智谱服务条款。

```bash
DSH_CHECKOUT=<checkout> bash scripts/build.sh
```
